job.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
job.pay_full: $115,500 – $165,000 a year base pay (excludes commission, bonus and equity, if applicable, and benefits)

details.about: Zscaler's Zero Trust Exchange is a cloud security platform that protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss, running across 200+ public data centers and thousands of private edge sites. This hybrid role in Santa Clara sits on the Data & APIs team in Engineering, reporting to the Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering: you'll architect and operate large-scale data pipelines and real-time streaming systems for multi-terabyte security telemetry, and the internal and customer-facing APIs that expose it.
duties: Design and build scalable, low-latency data services and REST/gRPC APIs over Zscaler's security telemetry, from design through production
Architect and tune large streaming and batch pipelines (Kafka, Spark/Flink) and the storage layer across Azure and GCP
Lead technical design of new subsystems through design docs, reviews, code review and testing strategy
Build AI/ML-enabled anomaly detection and signal correlation over streaming telemetry, with Product and Security Research
Find and fix bottlenecks in reliability, performance and developer velocity, using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows, and mentor others
needs: Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants, code-review tools and agentic workflows across the development life cycle
3–5 years of professional software engineering building and operating production backend services at scale, in Java, Python or Go
Deep experience designing and shipping production REST and/or gRPC APIs, including versioning, auth and backward compatibility
Hands-on experience building and operating large-scale streaming pipelines (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink or equivalent) at TB+/day scale
Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals and applying anomaly detection over streaming telemetry
Production ownership on Azure and/or GCP, with Kubernetes, observability and incident response
nice: Data platforms or APIs in security, networking or observability
Azure and GCP managed data services and lakehouse/warehouse stacks (Snowflake, Databricks, Iceberg, ClickHouse)
Mentoring engineers and driving cross-team initiatives
details.benefits: Base pay $115,500 – $165,000 a year, excluding commission, bonus and equity (if applicable) and benefits; the range covers all US locations. Benefits include various health plans, vacation and sick time, parental leave options, retirement options, education reimbursement and in-office perks.
notes: Hybrid role in Santa Clara, CA
